story: In the diverse world of birds, the Spot Winged Thrush (Suthora conspicillata) stands out. This species, part of the Sylviidae family, is a resident of temperate forest;subtropical or tropical moist montane forest. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Spot Winged Thrush is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Spot Winged Thrush and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
